paper.title: A Misaligned Debris Disk relative to the Host Star CPD-72 2713 from JWST/NIRCam Imaging

images.note: Left 'Data' panel of Fig. 1: Winnie MCRDI PSF-subtracted NIRCam F210M image (MASK335R), north up, east left, linear surface-brightness scale in MJy/sr (row colourbar outside the panel). Model fit: r0 = 55.4 (+3.0/-3.2) AU, i = 19.2 deg, PA = 164.7 deg; extended emission and an asymmetric NE/SW excess remain in the residuals.

notes: 1.33 mm ALMA Atacama Compact Array (7-m, ~7.4x5.5 arcsec beam) continuum detection at SNR~5.7 (Moor et al. 2020); the disk is only marginally resolved as an extended blob at this coarse ACA resolution rather than resolved into a ring in the image - the ring geometry (peak radius ~140 au) is inferred from uv-plane visibility modelling, not directly visible in the CLEAN image. Outstandingly large and dust-rich for a 24 Myr-old K7/M0 beta Pic moving-group member, motivating the 'big sibling of AU Mic' framing of Moor et al. (2020).
